messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: cont-batching tail latency SLO breach detected in us-west-2 · p95=1.2s, p99=2.9s (streaming path). Trigger: latency_p99 > 2s for 5m. Paging policy: oncall-level-1. Link: https://grafana.redwood/alert/contbatch-tail-usw2

alex_oncall: saw it — acknowledging. I'm on it. Paging came through at 09:14 UTC.

mike_sre: digging into trace data now. Initial read: spike correlates with mixed seq-len requests (many short prompts interleaved with very long ones). KV cache pressure high, eviction churn up ~3x.

sarah_infra: fwiw autoscaler didn't kick any new pods; GPU slots saturated on several hosts. Could be batching holding slots too long.

alex_oncall: immediate mitigation ideas: 1) temporarily reduce max_batch_size from 32 -> 8 for cont-batch runtime in usw2 2) enable strict scheduler fairness (preempt long seqs) 3) disable continuous batching for streaming routes. Anyone object?

jess_devex: +1 to dropping max_batch_size. Customer-facing streaming is what's suffering. If we drop it we should announce small blip to CSMs.

mike_sre: running quick prom query: ``sum(rate(requests_total[1m])) by (route), histogram_quantile(0.99, rate(request_latency_seconds_bucket[5m]))`` results attached. p99 for /stream/chat-route jumped from 0.9s -> 2.9s between 09:08-09:12 UTC.

alex_oncall: executing mitigation 1 now — hitting admin API to change batch config. Command: ``curl -X POST -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN' https://admin.redwood/api/v1/runtime/config -d '{"usw2": {"cont_batch":{"max_batch_size":8}}}'``

ops-bot: change-request accepted. Deploy job 3452 started.

mike_sre: also pushing a scheduler toggle patch to enable fairness_preemptive=true on the scheduler ring for contbatch tasks. Patch: ``kubectl -n inference patch config contbatch-scheduler --type=json -p '[{"op":"replace","path":"/spec/fairness","value":{"mode":"preemptive"}}]'``

sarah_infra: I'm going to evict oldest KV entries for the busiest hosts to reduce eviction churn. Running: ``redis-cli -h kv-cache-1 evict 1000`` (rolling through nodes).

alex_oncall: temporary route-level fallback enabled: /stream/chat-route -> fallback model small-stream (cpu) when latency > 1.5s for 30s. This should reduce error surface.

mike_sre: after batch size change and fairness toggle I see p99 drop starting at 09:19 UTC. Current readouts: p95=0.65s, p99=1.4s. Still above target for some traces but heading down.

jess_devex: customer impact: we saw ~12 distinct orgs with degraded streaming experience; 2 of them are on Dedicated (they reported multiple retries). Logged a note to CSMs and support: https://redwood.atlassian/INC-2145

ops-bot: Pager escalation updated: incident-level=mitigated; no longer paging oncall-level-2. Ops timeline recorded.

alex_oncall: quick summary for handoff:
- Root symptom: cont-batcher tail latency spike (p99 ~2.9s) caused by mixed sequence-length interleaving + KV cache churn + scheduler locking on large batches.
- Immediate mitigations taken (09:16-09:24 UTC): reduced cont_batch.max_batch_size 32->8; enabled scheduler fairness_preemptive; evicted stale KV keys on hot nodes; enabled route-level fallback to small-stream model.
- Impact: p99 reduced to ~1.4s within ~5-7 mins. ~12 orgs affected, 2 dedicated saw retries. No data loss.
- Next actions: 1) full trace sample dump to S3 (mike) 2) RCA ticket + postmortem (jess) 3) longer-term: scheduler qlen-aware batching and KV admission control (sarah).

mike_sre: started trace export: ``python tools/export_traces.py --from 2026-03-15T09:00 --to 2026-03-15T09:30 --tag contbatch --out s3://redwood-incident/1769998888/traces.jsonl`` job id 7782.

jess_devex: I'll spin up the incident doc draft: summary, customer impact, mitigations, timeline. Will tag CSMs and send the postmortem link here when ready.

sarah_infra: added a retention metric for KV evictions to infra backlog: RFC-1247. Also flagged nodes with highest eviction rates for hardware/network checks.

alex_oncall: handing off to mike_sre for midnight window monitoring and follow-ups — please keep this thread alive with any regressions. I've updated PagerDuty: oncall -> mike_sre.

mike_sre: taking it. I'll keep an eye on p99 and traces; if we see any rebound I'll consider temporary route throttling or pausing cont-batch for all streaming routes.

ops-bot: handoff recorded: from=alex_oncall to=mike_sre at=1769999400.

alex_oncall: thanks team — follow-ups: postmortem in 48h, action owner assignments in incident doc. I'll briefly notify support slack channel about mitigation summary. Signing off from active duty on this incident.

mike_sre: noted. current metrics as of 09:37 UTC: p95=0.6s, p99=1.2s for /stream/chat-route. Closing paging loop but monitor for 30m.

jess_devex: draft posted: https://docs.redwood/incidents/1769998888-contbatch-latency-draft (will lock after reviews).

incident-bot: INCIDENT CLOSED (mitigated) · duration 00:23:12 · root cause suspected: cont-batching + mixed seq-len + KV eviction churn. Postmortem: https://docs.redwood/incidents/1769998888-postmortem

mike_sre: leaving a final note — consider making a quick A/B: contbatch.max_batch_size auto-scale down when mixed-seq fraction > 40% to avoid this class of tails. Added to backlog ticket infra-rcs.

alex_oncall: agreed. good job everyone. :thumbsup:
